QUEZON CITY UNIVERSITY
OFFICE OF THE REGISTRAR
ACADEMIC ADVISORY NO. 12
Series of 2026

SUBJECT: SCHEDULE OF ENROLLMENT FOR THE SECOND SEMESTER, ACADEMIC YEAR 2025-2026

Please be advised that the online and on-campus enrollment for all undergraduate programs across all QCU campuses (San Bartolome, San Francisco, and Batasan) will strictly follow the schedule below:

1. Graduating Students: February 16, 2026
2. Regular Students (Third & Fourth Year): February 17-18, 2026
3. Regular Students (First & Second Year): February 19-20, 2026
4. Irregular / Transferee Students: February 23-24, 2026

Ensure all academic clearances are completed prior to enrollment.

QUEZON CITY UNIVERSITY
OFFICE OF STUDENT AFFAIRS AND SERVICES
SCHOLARSHIP AND FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE DIVISION

ADVISORY ON QUEZON CITY TERTIARY SCHOLARSHIP PROGRAM (QCTSP)

Applications for renewal and new grants for the upcoming academic semester are now officially open.
Eligible students may submit their requirements through the student affairs portal or at the SAS Office, 2nd Floor, Admin Building.
Deadline for submission is on March 5, 2026. Late submissions will not be entertained.
